preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10.
The number of elements n in each test case must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a[i] <= 10**9 for i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each element a[i] in the sequence must be between 1 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' if all(abs(a[i] - sorted_a[i]) <= 1 for i in range(n)) else 'NO'
postconditions.description: Output 'YES' if all elements are at most 1 position away from their sorted position, otherwise output 'NO'.
